title: Physical activity alleviated associations of oxidation capacity of the atmosphere with platelet-based inflammatory indicators: findings from the Henan Rural Cohort Study
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00611A, Paper
Xiaohuan Yang, Gongbo Chen, Wei Liao, Ziyuan Zhang, Xiaotian Liu, Ruiying Li, Xiaoyu Hou, Yinghao Yuchi, Zhenxing Mao, Wenqian Huo, Yuming Guo, Shanshan Li, Chongjian Wang, Jian Hou
Several adverse effects of ozone (O3) and nitrogen dioxide (NO2) are assessed using combined oxidant capacity (Ox) and redox-weighted oxidant capacity (Owtx) as surrogates.
